label: Initiated Brookhaven dimuon experiment
description: Leon Lederman and collaborators initiated experiments looking at single muons, then dimuons.

sources.quote: In the mid-sixties, Leon Lederman and his collaborators initiated a series of experiments looking first at single muons, then dimuons.

label: Proposed E70/E288/E494 experiments
description: The series of experiments was proposed by Leon and his collaborators.

sources.quote: The series of experiments E70/E288/E494 was proposed by Leon and his collaborators on June 17, 1970.

label: Proposal #288 to Fermilab management
description: Proposal titled 'A Study of Di-Lepton Production in Proton Collisions at NAL'.

sources.quote: Proposal # 288 to the Fermilab management, \A Study of Di-Lepton Production in Proton Collisions at NAL," was dated February of 1974.

label: Memo on dimuons without movable filter
description: Leon's memo starting with 'We propose to do dimuons without a movable filter'.

sources.quote: Leon's 2/12/75 memo starting with the words \We propose to do dimuons without a movable filter using fixed beryllium filter to attenuate hadrons."

label: Signed Super 288 White Paper
description: White Paper signed by Leon and Taiji.

sources.quote: The \Super 288 White Paper," signed by Leon and Taiji, dated January 28, 1976.

label: First hint of Upsilon
description: Clustering of events near 9.5GeV noticed in dielectron data.

sources.quote: We found the first evidence of the in November 1976 in an early phase of E288.

label: Discovery of Upsilon particle
description: Discovery announced at Fermilab, PRL paper submitted.

sources.quote: On June 30th, 1977, Steve Herb announced the discovery at Fermilab.

label: Offered directorship of Fermilab
description: Leon was given an offer he couldn't refuse - directorship of Fermilab.

sources.quote: Unfortunately, soon after the experiment was approved, Leon was given an offer he couldn't refuse | directorship of Fermilab.
